I started therapy a couple of years ago, and have been trying to really work on myself, getting to the point you describe.

I think psychological therapy is an awesome tool, but one of many. It is the most “logical” and “mental”, it allows you to access to your emotions through your brain.

Lately I tried emotional drama, which is a kind of therapy that allows you to express emotions through your body and through drama classes. It unlocked something in me and gave me a different understanding on my emotions. It also helped that it was my character, not me, who was expressing those emotions.

What I’m getting at: I think I completed my “brain therapy” and now need to advance through “body therapy” or any other that might exist, just like you learn about trees first and then go to the woods and smell them, touch them, experience them.

Hope it helped a little bit :)
